newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK & China Gas down after earnings report.
newsitem.headline: HK & China Gas down after earnings report.

text.p: Shares of Hong Kong and China Gas Co Ltd fell in early afternoon trade after the company reported a 20 percent rise in interim earnings at midday, brokers said.
"Investors are taking profit after it reported earnings which were in line with general market expectations," said Michael Ng, analyst from ASG Brokerage.
The shares fell HK$0.15 to an intraday low of HK$12.70 in early afternoon trade on volume of 3.10 million shares.
The stock had gained HK$0.35, or 2.80 percent, over the last six trading days.
The gas producer and distributor posted a 20.1 percent rise in interim earnings to HK$979.1 million.

Brokers said they expected the share sto consolidate after the downward adjustment and said the shares were worth buying for the long term since utility companies' earnings were less affected by economic changes.
